layout.initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: top-down level layout reference for the small third-person 3D indie RPG 未名之海, 灯汀湾 shore prototype.
Input image 1: approved scene STYLE, MATERIAL, LIGHTING and LANDMARK reference. Create a new bird's-eye layout of THIS SAME PLACE. Preserve its warm ivory stone and plaster, softly painted weathered wood, sage vegetation, jade-teal water, amber lanterns, lavender-blue distance, cozy lived-in garden ruins. This is an exploratory production reference, not a game screenshot or finished surveyed plan.
Output: one beautiful readable orthographic NEAR-VERTICAL TOP-DOWN landscape image, north at top. Almost straight down, very little side elevation. NOT another low-angle landscape, NOT isometric, NOT a collection of panels. Show a compact shore and its little bay as a coherent connected piece of land; cropping shows enough northern bay to locate the old bell tower.
Authoritative layout shared with two subsequent player-view images:
- Land in the LOWER THIRD of frame forms a wide gently curved shore; water occupies upper center and right. A wider bank runs up the LEFT edge of the bay, curving around the far northern water toward a small rocky BELL TOWER promontory at UPPER RIGHT. The tower is a distant landmark beyond the first small playable shore, not a new town.
- The SOUP SHELTER is at LOWER LEFT / southwest of the short dock: modest rounded ivory plaster/stone hut, cream fabric awning opening toward the shore, wooden serving counter, a bench, warm lamps. Roof partly cut away ONLY locally to show counter, do not remove the entire building roof. No added multi-building village.
- A single small WORKBENCH sits immediately EAST / to the right of the shelter on its own dry apron, outdoors, not on the dock.
- The wooden FISHING DOCK is near CENTER / slightly below center, rooted at the north edge of the foreground shore and extending NORTH into the water, one short straight rectangular platform with a warm wooden-post lamp at the far-right corner. Keep exactly one dock.
- The PLAYER ARRIVAL PATH enters at BOTTOM CENTER from south. It forks toward the shelter on left, continues to the dock ahead, and connects east to a broad clear sandy-grassy COMBAT CLEARING in LOWER RIGHT. The clearing stays roomy and mostly empty, no enemies, no props or flowers blocking its center.
- A small OLD STONE ARCH with attached low curved limestone wall stands EAST / right of the clearing, on the lower-right shoreline; a short dry path leads through it. Arch opening never ends directly in water. No door.
- Decorative rocks, reeds and white wildflowers frame paths and shoreline, not spread across the playable center. One leafy tree near shelter, shallow grass patches, a few clay jars. Keep path widths believable for a human and free movement.
- Future access to the distant bell tower is suggested by the LEFT bank path around the bay, visually de-emphasized. Do not add boats, bridges across the whole bay, navigation gear, docks elsewhere, new castle, market or extra towers.
Graphic treatment: the scenery itself should be attractive richly shaded stylized 3D environmental art, matching the reference, with neatly legible but restrained Chinese callout labels in small ivory boxes at the outer margins and thin fine leaders. Labels only these exact texts: “汤棚”, “工作台”, “钓台”, “战斗空地”, “旧庭石拱门”, “远景铃塔”. Leader ends must point at the correct respective objects. Add a small unobtrusive “北” with upward arrow at top left. A simple thin dashed warm-ochre main-route line follows the bottom-center path, forks to shelter, dock and clearing, never crosses water. No dense grid, no precise measurements, no extra legend or title text, no fake game UI or watermark.
Priorities: consistent spatial relation and readable usable circulation first, beautiful materials and lighting second, manageable indie scene scope. Empty combat clearing and clear dock access are mandatory.
layout.revision_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / precise camera viewpoint revision.
Input image 1 is the existing level layout to preserve. Input image 2 is the approved art-style reference. Produce ONE corrected layout image, with ONE essential change: rotate the camera to a TRUE VERTICAL TOP-DOWN ORTHOGRAPHIC MAP, looking STRAIGHT DOWN at the ground, 90 degrees downward. No skyline or horizon. No isometric perspective, no diagonal aerial viewpoint, no front-facing building facades. This must read as a beautiful painted 3D level floorplan from above, not another elevated landscape.
Keep all landmark placement and route connectivity from image1: soup shelter lower left, outdoor workbench immediately right/east of shelter, ONE straight fishing dock at center extending toward top/north into water, open combat clearing lower right, stone arch at right/east of clearing with dry land continuing through it, bell tower promontory upper right, bank path rising along left edge of bay. South arrival path comes from bottom center and branches left to shelter, north to dock, east to clearing. Do not mirror or exchange any objects.
Because camera is straight down, show hut as roof/awning shapes, dock as rectangular top planks, bell tower as roofless square masonry ring with tiny visible bell inside, and arch/wall as narrow masonry top footprint; do not tilt these objects toward the viewer. Walls and tree canopies may cast short gentle shadows to reveal height. Partially cut away canopy only where needed to read counter. Keep all built geometry in consistent top-down projection.
Match the ivory, sage, weathered wood, teal water, warm lamps of reference2, rich but controlled hand-painted game materials. Retain exposed broad ground and empty combat center. Keep the scene compact and connected, no added buildings, docks, boats or extra islands. Keep water in upper center/right and accessible land across bottom and along left bank.
Retain only six neat legible Chinese labels, with short thin leaders pointing correctly: 汤棚, 工作台, 钓台, 战斗空地, 旧庭石拱门, 远景铃塔. Small 北 arrow up at top-left. Dashed muted ochre walking-route line follows dry ground from southern entrance to shelter, dock, clearing; never over water. No grid, no numerical scale, no game UI, no big title, no watermark. Wide landscape image, all major land paths visible. Spatial diagram readability is more important than cinematic atmosphere.

player_views.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one third-person player-view environment reference for 未名之海, 灯汀湾. Not a delivered game screenshot.
Inputs: Image1 is the approved environment ART STYLE and landmark design reference; Image2 is the authoritative SHORE LAYOUT reference; Image3 is the traveler appearance reference, only for the small on-screen player. Use all three together. Render the SAME PLACE from a new ground-level camera, NOT a new redesigned level.
Preserve: rounded ivory stone/plaster soup shelter with patched cream awning and warm lamps, outdoor wooden workbench immediately to its east/right, ONE straight short wooden fishing dock at the north shore with lamp at its far right corner, open sandy-grassy combat clearing east of the dock approach, low curved limestone wall and small stone arch east of clearing, distant half-ruined bell tower across the bay on a rocky promontory. Southern arrival path branches west to shelter, north to dock, east to clearing, as in map. Bank path curves north along west shore toward the far tower. No new buildings, piers, markets, boats, extra towers or enemies.
Style: match image1's beautiful softly hand-painted stylized 3D game environment, jade-teal water, sage grass, pale limestone, weathered timber, warm amber lamps, soft lilac blue distant mist, natural bright readability. Moderate geometry with selective lovely details, no photorealism or coarse blockout. Keep traverse areas broad and uncluttered; flowers and reeds frame edges, not the middle of paths. No harsh bloom, no heavy motion blur, no fake screenshot UI, no labels, arrows, caption, watermark or panels.
Character: one small adult traveler seen from behind, ivory short jacket, short pale shoulder cloth, dark cropped trousers, brown ankle boots and small hip pouch, matching image3. Empty hands, no weapon, natural standing pose, no giant cape. Frame the full body from head to boots, at lower center around 18-24 percent of image height, enough visible ground nearby to judge movement space. Camera approximately 2.3m high, 4m behind traveler, moderate wide field of view, landscape 16:9, no cinematic close-up, eye-level horizon, playable third-person framing.
The layout image provides relative position and routes, not a license to tilt a bird's-eye drawing into the player view. Reconstruct coherent 3D space and camera projection.
Exact camera A: camera and player are on the SOUTHERN ARRIVAL PATH just before its three-way fork, looking NORTH toward the fishing dock. Dock is in front of the player near center, the shelter and outdoor workbench read together at left, combat clearing is visible to right with enough empty dry ground, arch farther right at its boundary, bell tower across water in right-of-center distance. Closely preserve image1 composition and atmosphere but use a lower practical follow-camera framing and include the clearing from image2. Do not put a second dock near shelter. The player's feet remain on the arrival path, not already on the dock. All circulation in foreground connects on dry land.

Preserve image1's entire camera position, player position and design, shelter, dock, distant bell tower, clearing, style, lighting and composition. Change ONLY these local details for consistency with the layout: the small wooden CRAFTING WORKBENCH currently at the RIGHT beside the low wall must be moved to the LEFT, on the dry stone apron between the soup shelter's steps and the dock approach. Exactly one crafting workbench. The right-side combat clearing must remain mostly EMPTY, with the low wall, lantern and arch as before but no table there. Keep a clear walking path around the workbench at left. The visible stone arch at far right must have a fully OPEN dry passage, remove any gate bars or picket closure inside the opening; preserve the stone arch itself. Do not add new props, buildings, characters or extra docks. No labels, UI, text or watermark. Retain original image1 wide landscape composition and all unaffected details.
